definition.export: export_state returns canonical UTF-8 JSON bytes: schema, key kind, read mode, exported policy, capacity, peak capacity, counters, rejected reasons, records and correction log
definition.import: BridgeTable.from_state validates the whole payload before constructing; key_fn and allowed_authorities belong to the importing table, not to the payload
definition.round_trip: the 18-key table with two audited corrections must round-trip with equal full digest, equal content digest, equal exported bytes, the same authority/reason log, 40/40 and 0/0
definition.empty: an empty table must round-trip with the same full digest
definition.policy: importing into a stricter table keeps records and the old log, but a new correction with the old authority is rejected and one with the new authority is accepted
definition.corrupt: truncated bytes, wrong schema, duplicate key and negative count must each raise ValueError before any table is returned
definition.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
definition.rerun_anchors: R18-R21 carry the commit at which their own runner bytes were last runnable, because R22 changes the bridge module their manifests pin

criteria.round_trip: full digest equal, content digest equal, exported bytes equal, log length 2 with the same authorities and reasons, alias reads the original value
criteria.empty: full digest before export equals full digest after import
criteria.policy: content digest equal; records preserved; old authority rejected as rejected_batch_unknown_authority; new authority accepted; old log still carries the old authority
criteria.corrupt: four payloads each raise ValueError whose message starts with rejected_import_invalid_state
criteria.rerun: four anchor rows each carry a commit, a runner blob sha1, a runner sha256 and a report bridge sha256
criteria.closed_state: the nine closed-state readings stay equal before and after
criteria.reporting: a successful import is evidence of portability, not of semantic understanding; the policy of the importing table is reported separately from the exported policy
